source: Client brief 2026-10-18 (MENA Magnesium Glycinate: definition, segmentation, region, exclusions, key companies) + report sample 'Sample_MENA_Magnesium Glycinate Market_Coherent_Market_Insights.pdf' (profile groups: Finished Product Manufacturers, Brand Owners / Marketers -- distributors and pharmacies / retailers / e-commerce excluded); 10 browsers
market_definition: The MENA Magnesium Glycinate Market covers magnesium glycinate supplements and finished formulations containing magnesium glycinate as an active nutritional ingredient. The market includes powder, capsules, tablets, softgels, gummies, oral solutions, liquids, and sachets, along with single-ingredient and combination formulations (with vitamins, minerals, herbal/botanical ingredients, amino acids, multi-magnesium) used for magnesium supplementation, general wellness, sleep and relaxation, stress management, muscle health, women's health, sports recovery, and other nutritional applications across the Middle East and North Africa (GCC: Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain; Egypt, Morocco, Algeria, Libya, Sudan, Tunisia, Jordan, Lebanon, Iraq, Yemen), sold through retail and hospital pharmacies, clinics, e-commerce, health and wellness stores, supermarkets, specialty nutrition stores and direct to consumer.
core_scope: A core player is a BRAND OWNER or FINISHED-PRODUCT MANUFACTURER that sells, under its own brand, a finished supplement containing magnesium glycinate (single-ingredient or combination: powder, capsules, tablets, softgels, gummies, liquids or sachets), AND that product is available in at least one MENA country (GCC, Egypt, Morocco, Algeria, Libya, Sudan, Tunisia, Jordan, Lebanon, Iraq, Yemen) -- through pharmacies, retailers, e-commerce or a local distributor. International brands sold in MENA and local MENA brands both qualify; the company need not be headquartered in MENA.
adjacent_segments: Magnesium supplements that do not contain magnesium glycinate (other magnesium salts sold as standalone products)
General vitamin, mineral and dietary supplement brands with no magnesium glycinate product
Food, beverage and cosmetic products outside the nutritional supplement market
Pharmaceutical products not containing magnesium glycinate
Raw-material and ingredient suppliers (magnesium glycinate powder / bisglycinate chelate makers) not selling finished supplements
Distributors, importers and nutraceutical distribution companies of other companies' brands
Pharmacies, retailers, supermarkets and e-commerce platforms (sales channels)
Brands whose magnesium glycinate products are not available in any MENA country
scope: ONLY brand owners and finished-product manufacturers that sell, under their own brand, a finished supplement containing magnesium glycinate (single-ingredient or combination; any dose form) that is available in at least one MENA country (GCC, Egypt, Morocco, Algeria, Libya, Sudan, Tunisia, Jordan, Lebanon, Iraq, Yemen). International and local MENA brands both qualify. NOT in this market: Magnesium supplements that do not contain magnesium glycinate (other magnesium salts sold as standalone products); General vitamin, mineral and dietary supplement brands with no magnesium glycinate product; Food, beverage and cosmetic products outside the nutritional supplement market; Pharmaceutical products not containing magnesium glycinate; Raw-material and ingredient suppliers (magnesium glycinate powder / bisglycinate chelate makers) not selling finished supplements; Distributors, importers and nutraceutical distribution companies of other companies' brands; Pharmacies, retailers, supermarkets and e-commerce platforms (sales channels); Brands whose magnesium glycinate products are not available in any MENA country.
